summary: Iteration 2 testing (Twilio WhatsApp, Team invites, Documents upload/download to Emergent Object Storage, Automation engine + runs). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed. Frontend: nav-equipe/Team, Documentos dropzone+upload+download, Automações tabs+test+runs, CRM lead-phone, WA config badge all verified. Twilio channel-not-enabled scenarios return status='error/skipped' without 5xx as expected. Multi-tenant scoping preserved (all queries use org_id).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription — console a11y warning (already flagged in iteration 1).
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount (harmless, from iteration 1).

Download/Delete icons only appear on hover (opacity-0 → group-hover:opacity-100). Data-testid remains in DOM so tests pass, but touch/keyboard users cannot access them. Consider always-visible on small screens.

action_items: (Optional) Make document card actions (download/delete) keyboard-accessible; hover-only hides them from touch/a11y users.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to invite/new-doc/new-auto/edit-auto/new-chat DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warnings.

(Optional) WhatsApp outgoing when Twilio channel isn't WA-enabled: server correctly stores delivery='mock' (fallback) — verified. Consider surfacing a toast when Twilio attempt returned error so operator knows message went via mock only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 924 lines — still recommended to split into modules (auth, crm, wa, documents, automations, team, copilot).

download_doc uses ad-hoc `auth` query param fallback in addition to cookie+bearer; that param isn't documented and not used by UI. Either remove or document (`?auth=<token>` currently works as an auth bypass surface).
Team change_role endpoint allows owner to change ANY user in the org including themselves; safeguard to prevent org losing its only owner (demoting self when sole owner) is missing.
wa_webhook is public (no signature validation). Twilio X-Twilio-Signature check should be added before production.
PATCH /crm/leads only supports {stage,phone} — other fields (name/email/value/company/notes) cannot be updated after creation.
storage_put/storage_get are synchronous (blocking pyrequests) inside async endpoints — will block the event loop on large uploads. Use httpx.AsyncClient.
Automation engine: no per-org rate limiting or de-dup, so a burst of leads can trigger many WA/email calls — consider a simple debounce or per-run guard.
